```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/setup.R")
```

## Read in the data

Youth aged 2–20 years with valid height and weight (`kids`). DXA analyses use participants
aged 8–20 with a complete whole-body scan (`kids_dxa`); NHANES does not scan younger children.

```{r}
kids     <- read_result("kids")
kids_dxa <- read_result("kids_dxa")

cli::cli_alert_info("Youth: {nrow(kids)}; with DXA (8–20 y): {nrow(kids_dxa)}")
kids     |> count(age, sex) |> pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = n) |> knitr::kable()
kids_dxa |> count(sex) |> knitr::kable()
```

## Table 2: allometric exponent β by age and sex

The log–log regression of weight on height (Table 1, Equation 3) is fit at each single
year of age: separately for females and males, and once with sex as a covariate (sex-adjusted).

```{r}
beta_sex <- beta_by_stratum(kids, "age")
beta_adj <- beta_by_stratum(kids, "age", adjust_sex = TRUE)

table2 <- bind_rows(beta_sex, beta_adj |> mutate(sex = "Sex-adjusted")) |>
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Females", "Males", "Sex-adjusted"))) |>
  select(age, sex, n, beta, se, lo, hi, r2, p_int) |>
  arrange(age, sex)

table2 |>
  mutate(cell = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", beta, se)) |>
  select(age, sex, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = cell) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

### Table 2 in-text values

```{r}
adj <- function(a) beta_adj |> filter(age %in% a) |> pull(beta)
record_stat("youth_beta_age11",   adj(11))
record_stat("box_beta_age2",      adj(2))
record_stat("box_beta_peak_min",  min(adj(8:11)))
record_stat("box_beta_peak_max",  max(adj(8:11)))
record_stat("box_beta_16_20_min", min(adj(16:20)))
record_stat("box_beta_16_20_max", max(adj(16:20)))
```

### Benn's index exponents

Benn's index uses the **sex-specific** β for each age (Table 2, female and male columns).

```{r}
benn_beta <- beta_sex |> select(age, sex, beta_benn = beta)

kids     <- kids     |> left_join(benn_beta, by = join_by(age, sex)) |> mutate(benn = weight_kg / height_m^beta_benn)
kids_dxa <- kids_dxa |> left_join(benn_beta, by = join_by(age, sex)) |> mutate(benn = weight_kg / height_m^beta_benn)
stopifnot(!anyNA(kids$benn))

save_result(table2, "res_table2")
```

## Figure 3: β, growth velocity, and the height–BMI correlation

### Figure 3A: β by age

Points are the sex-adjusted estimates (Table 2); the curves smooth the sex-specific and
sex-adjusted estimates (drawn in `figures/fig03_*.R`).

```{r}
fig3a <- table2 |> mutate(sex = fct_recode(sex, All = "Sex-adjusted"))
```

### Figure 3B: growth velocity

Difference in median height between consecutive single years of age, plotted at the older
age (ages 3–19, as in v1).

```{r}
fig3b <- growth_velocity(kids) |> filter(age >= 3, age <= 19)
fig3b |> select(sex, age, velocity) |> pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = velocity) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

### Figure 3C: Pearson correlation of BMI with height

By age and sex, plus the pooled sample ("All", sexes combined and unadjusted for sex).

```{r}
fig3c <- bind_rows(
  kids |> group_by(age, sex) |> group_modify(~ cor_summary(.x, "height_m", "bmi")) |> ungroup(),
  kids |> group_by(age)      |> group_modify(~ cor_summary(.x, "height_m", "bmi")) |> ungroup() |>
    mutate(sex = "All")
) |>
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("All", "Females", "Males")),
         signif = p < opts$p_star)

r_at <- function(s, a) fig3c |> filter(sex == s, age == a) |> pull(r)
record_stat("youth_r_bmi_height_f7", r_at("Females", 7))
record_stat("youth_r_bmi_height_m8", r_at("Males", 8))

fig3c |> filter(sex != "All") |> slice_max(r, n = 1, by = sex) |> knitr::kable(digits = 3)

save_result(list(beta = fig3a, velocity = fig3b, r_bmi_height = fig3c), "res_fig3")
```

## Figure 4: height-dependent bias in BMI

If relative weight is W/H^β, two children with the same relative weight but heights H and H₀
differ in BMI by (H/H₀)^(β−2) − 1. The β values are the sex-adjusted Table 2 estimates.

```{r}
bias_stages <- tibble(
  stage = c("Adult-like", "Age 3 NHANES", "Age 5 NHANES", "Age 11 NHANES"),
  beta  = c(2, adj(3), adj(5), adj(11))
) |>
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s (β = %.2f)", stage, beta))

fig4 <- expand_grid(bias_stages, rel_height = seq(0.90, 1.10, by = 0.005)) |>
  mutate(bias_pct = 100 * (rel_height^(beta - 2) - 1))

record_stat("bias_age11_plus10",  100 * (1.10^(adj(11) - 2) - 1))
record_stat("bias_age11_minus10", 100 * (0.90^(adj(11) - 2) - 1))

save_result(fig4, "res_fig4")
```

## Figure 5: height and %BF (DXA, 8–20 y)

### Figure 5A: Pearson correlation of height with %BF, by age and sex

```{r}
fig5a <- kids_dxa |>
  group_by(age, sex) |>
  group_modify(~ cor_summary(.x, "height_m", "pbf")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(signif = p < opts$p_star)

fig5a |> select(age, sex, r) |> pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = r) |> knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

### Sex-adjusted partial correlation (Box; youth part of Figure 2B)

```{r}
hf_youth <- hf_corr(kids_dxa, "age")
hf_youth |> select(age, n, r, lo, hi, p_int) |> knitr::kable(digits = 3)

record_stat("box_partial_r_8_11_min", min(hf_youth$r[hf_youth$age %in% 8:11]))
record_stat("box_partial_r_8_11_max", max(hf_youth$r[hf_youth$age %in% 8:11]))
```

### Figure 5B: mean %BF by height quartile within age and sex

Height quartiles are formed within each age × sex stratum of the DXA sample. CIs are 95%
bootstrap percentile intervals (`r opts$n_boot` resamples).

```{r}
set.seed(opts$seed)
fig5b <- kids_dxa |>
  group_by(age, sex) |>
  mutate(height_q = ntile(height_m, 4)) |>
  group_by(age, sex, height_q) |>
  reframe(boot_mean_ci(pbf)) |>
  mutate(height_q = factor(height_q, labels = c("Q1 (shortest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (tallest)")))

save_result(list(r_height_pbf = fig5a, quartiles = fig5b), "res_fig5")
```

## Figure 6: how well do BMI, TMI and Benn's index explain %BF?

R² is the squared Pearson correlation of %BF with each index, within age × sex. One paired
bootstrap (`r opts$n_boot` resamples) per stratum gives the CIs for each R² and for each
difference from Benn's index.

```{r}
set.seed(opts$seed)
indices <- c(BMI = "bmi", TMI = "tmi", Benn = "benn")

r2_res <- kids_dxa |>
  group_by(age, sex) |>
  group_map(~ r2_boot(.x, indices, ref = "Benn") |>
              map(mutate, age = .y$age, sex = .y$sex), .keep = FALSE)

fig6a <- map_dfr(r2_res, "r2")   |> mutate(index = factor(index, levels = names(indices)))
fig6b <- map_dfr(r2_res, "diff")

### Figure 6C: does the ΔR² track the height–%BF correlation (Figure 5A)?
fig6c <- fig6b |> inner_join(fig5a |> select(age, sex, r_height_pbf = r), by = join_by(age, sex))
dep_r <- fig6c |> group_by(index) |> summarise(r = cor(r_height_pbf, delta_r2), n = n())
dep_r |> knitr::kable(digits = 3)

record_stat("fig6_r_bmi_benn", dep_r$r[dep_r$index == "BMI − Benn"])
record_stat("fig6_r_tmi_benn", dep_r$r[dep_r$index == "TMI − Benn"])

# participants per sex (the n quoted in the Fig 5 and Fig 6 legends)
fig6a |> distinct(age, sex, n) |> count(sex, wt = n) |> knitr::kable()

save_result(list(r2 = fig6a, diff = fig6b, dependence = fig6c, dependence_r = dep_r), "res_fig6")
```

## Figure 7: growth and weight–stature indices by age

Thin-plate GAM smooths of each measure on age, by sex, fit to all participants. Only the
smooths are saved (aggregate).

```{r}
fig7 <- kids |>
  transmute(sex, age, `Height (cm)` = height_cm, `Weight (kg)` = weight_kg,
            `BMI (kg/m²)` = bmi, `TMI (kg/m³)` = tmi, `Benn's index (kg/mᵝ)` = benn) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(sex, age), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(measure = fct_inorder(measure)) |>
  smooth_by("age", "value", group = c("measure", "sex")) |>
  rename(age = x, value = y) |>
  mutate(panel = if_else(measure %in% c("Height (cm)", "Weight (kg)"), "A", "B"))

save_result(fig7, "res_fig7")
```

## Compositional stability in youth (Figure 8B; youth part of Figure 2C)

### Sex-specific curves by single year of age (Figure 8B)

```{r}
curves_youth <- fit_stratum_curves(kids_dxa |> mutate(age_grp = factor(age)), "age_grp")
pbf25_youth  <- pbf_at_ref(curves_youth)

pbf25_youth |> select(sex, age_grp, pbf) |> pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = pbf) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)

get_pbf <- function(s, a) pbf25_youth |> filter(sex == s, age_grp == a) |> pull(pbf)
record_stat("youth_pbf25_m8",      get_pbf("Males", 8))
record_stat("youth_pbf25_m20",     get_pbf("Males", 20))
record_stat("youth_pbf25_m_delta", get_pbf("Males", 20) - get_pbf("Males", 8))
record_stat("youth_pbf25_f8",      get_pbf("Females", 8))
record_stat("youth_pbf25_f20",     get_pbf("Females", 20))
record_stat("youth_pbf25_f_delta", get_pbf("Females", 20) - get_pbf("Females", 8))
record_stat("box_pbf25_age8",   mean(c(get_pbf("Females", 8), get_pbf("Males", 8))), "mean of F and M")
record_stat("box_pbf25_f_1920", mean(c(get_pbf("Females", 19), get_pbf("Females", 20))), "mean of ages 19 and 20")
record_stat("box_pbf25_m_1920", mean(c(get_pbf("Males", 19), get_pbf("Males", 20))), "mean of ages 19 and 20")

pbf_sweep_youth <- pbf_at_ref(curves_youth, opts$ref_bmi_sweep)
save_result(list(curves = curves_youth, pbf25 = pbf25_youth, sweep = pbf_sweep_youth), "res_youth_curves")
```

### Sex-adjusted %BF at BMI 25 (youth part of Figure 2C)

```{r}
curves_youth_adj <- fit_stratum_curves(kids_dxa |> mutate(age_grp = factor(age)), "age_grp", adjust_sex = TRUE)
pbf25_youth_adj  <- pbf_at_ref(curves_youth_adj)

save_result(list(beta = beta_adj, hf = hf_youth, pbf25 = pbf25_youth_adj), "res_youth_strata")
```

### Mean BMI and %BF at ages 8 and 20 (text: compositional ¶3; Figure 9 legend)

```{r}
means_8_20 <- kids_dxa |>
  filter(age %in% c(8, 20)) |>
  group_by(sex, age) |>
  summarise(n = n(), bmi = mean(bmi), pbf = mean(pbf), .groups = "drop")
means_8_20 |> knitr::kable(digits = 1)

chg <- function(s, v) diff(means_8_20[[v]][means_8_20$sex == s])
record_stat("youth_bmi_change_8_20_f", chg("Females", "bmi"))
record_stat("youth_bmi_change_8_20_m", chg("Males",   "bmi"))
record_stat("youth_pbf_change_8_20_f", chg("Females", "pbf"))
record_stat("youth_pbf_change_8_20_m", chg("Males",   "pbf"))
record_stat("fig9_boys_bmi_age8",  means_8_20$bmi[means_8_20$sex == "Males" & means_8_20$age == 8])
record_stat("fig9_boys_bmi_age20", means_8_20$bmi[means_8_20$sex == "Males" & means_8_20$age == 20])
```

## Figure 10: deriving BMI-for-age percentiles (illustration, males 2–19 y)

Unweighted empirical percentiles within single-year age groups; smoothing across age is done
in the figure script. Ages 2–19 reproduce the "112 children (0.57%)" in the legend
(DISCREPANCIES B10).

```{r}
pcts <- c(0.03, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 0.97)
pct_labels <- c("3rd", "5th", "10th", "25th", "50th", "75th", "85th", "90th", "95th", "97th")

males_2_19 <- kids |> filter(sex == "Males", age >= 2, age <= 19)

fig10_pct <- males_2_19 |>
  group_by(age) |>
  reframe(percentile = pct_labels, p = pcts, bmi = quantile(bmi, pcts), n = n()) |>
  mutate(percentile = factor(percentile, levels = pct_labels))

y_cap <- 43
record_stat("fig10_n_above_43",   sum(males_2_19$bmi > y_cap))
record_stat("fig10_pct_above_43", 100 * mean(males_2_19$bmi > y_cap))

save_result(list(percentiles = fig10_pct, n = nrow(males_2_19), y_cap = y_cap), "res_fig10")
```

## Figure 11 and the z-score example: the CDC 2022 BMI-for-age reference

```{r}
cdc <- read_csv(paths$cdc_lms, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(agemos >= 24) |>
  mutate(sex = factor(if_else(sex == 2, "Females", "Males"), levels = c("Females", "Males")),
         age = agemos / 12)

record_stat("fig11_L_max", max(cdc$L))
record_stat("fig11_L_min", min(cdc$L))

fig11 <- list(
  lms = cdc |> select(sex, agemos, age, L, M, S),
  percentiles = cdc |>
    select(sex, agemos, age, P5, P25, P50, P75, P85, P95, pct120ofP95) |>
    pivot_longer(-c(sex, agemos, age), names_to = "percentile", values_to = "bmi") |>
    mutate(percentile = factor(percentile,
                               levels = c("P5", "P25", "P50", "P75", "P85", "P95", "pct120ofP95"),
                               labels = c("5th", "25th", "50th", "75th", "85th", "95th", "120% of 95th")))
)
save_result(fig11, "res_fig11")
```

### z-score compression: a 9-year-old boy, 130 cm tall

The CDC row for males at 108.5 months (age 9.0 y); weights in pairs 8 kg apart.

```{r}
row9 <- cdc |> filter(sex == "Males", agemos == 108.5)
z_example <- tibble(weight_kg = c(34, 42, 51, 59, 77, 85)) |>
  mutate(bmi = weight_kg / 1.30^2, z = lms_z(bmi, row9$L, row9$M, row9$S))
z_example |> knitr::kable(digits = 2)

iwalk(z_example$bmi, ~ record_stat(paste0("z_bmi_", .y), .x))
iwalk(z_example$z,   ~ record_stat(paste0("z_", .y), .x))
record_stat("z_diff_healthy", round(z_example$z[2], 2) - round(z_example$z[1], 2), "difference of the rounded z-scores, as in the text")
record_stat("z_diff_obese",   round(z_example$z[4], 2) - round(z_example$z[3], 2), "difference of the rounded z-scores")
record_stat("z_diff_severe",  round(z_example$z[6], 2) - round(z_example$z[5], 2), "difference of the rounded z-scores")
record_stat("z_max_age9",     lms_zmax(row9$L, row9$S))
```
